purposeAndApplication.purpose: The Ngai Shing NS-2410 is an industrial garment finishing machine designed for folding and rotary pressing triangular sleeve plackets used in shirt and garment manufacturing. It uses a conveyor-based rotary pressing system combined with interchangeable folder attachments to create different sleeve placket styles with consistent quality.
applications: Folding and pressing triangular sleeve plackets for shirts and garments
Producing repeatable sleeve placket shapes with consistent fold quality
Replacing manual folding and pressing work in sleeve finishing operations
Supporting different sleeve placket styles using interchangeable folder attachments
Conveyor-assisted continuous production for improved throughput

title: Ngai Shing NS-2410 Rotary Pressing Machine
subtitle: Sleeve Placket Folding and Rotary Pressing Machine
overviewDescription: The Ngai Shing NS-2410 is an industrial sleeve placket folding and rotary pressing machine manufactured by Ngai Shing Development Limited. It combines conveyor movement, interchangeable folder attachments, heat pressing, and pressure stabilization to produce consistent sleeve placket shapes. The machine supports multiple folder systems for different placket styles and an optional automatic collecting system.

workingPrinciples.heading: 1. Folder-Based Shaping
workingPrinciples.description: The operator installs the required folder attachment for the sleeve placket style needed. The folder mechanism folds the fabric into the required shape as it enters the machine. Multiple interchangeable folders (F537–F543) support different placket styles.

workingPrinciples.heading: 2. Conveyor Transfer System
workingPrinciples.description: A roller conveyor belt system continuously transfers the fabric from the feeding section through the folder and into the rotary pressing section. This enables continuous production and reduces manual handling.

workingPrinciples.heading: 3. Rotary Heat Pressing
workingPrinciples.description: The rotary pressing section applies heat (up to 200°C, controlled by infrared thermostat sensor) and adjustable pressure to stabilize the fold and produce a consistent sleeve placket shape. The heat fixes the crease permanently.

workingPrinciples.heading: 4. Optional Auto Collection
workingPrinciples.description: An optional automatic collecting system (O-C-08-01) can be installed to receive finished pieces as they exit the machine, further reducing manual handling and improving production flow.
